Class XMLWriter

java.lang.Object
common.xml.XMLWriter
All Implemented Interfaces:
CommonConstants, EngineNodeConstants, XMLConstantNames
public class XMLWriter extends Object implements CommonConstants, XMLConstantNames

Title: XML Writer

Description: Writes model information to an XML file. This class provides methods for model save.
